outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Fulham FC 1.68 vs Newcastle United FC 1.59, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: Fulham FC at home: 1W-1D-2L, 6 scored and 7 conceded in 4 games.
Newcastle United FC away: 2W-0D-2L, 6 scored and 8 conceded in 4 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.50 goals per game, away teams 1.20.
Recent league form (newest first): Fulham FC DWWLD, Newcastle United FC LWLLW (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: Fulham FC has 4 home games and Newcastle United FC 4 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
